terms.definition: A semantic component that connects one visible claim to its supporting observations.
notThis: A decorative divider without claim-to-proof meaning.
acceptance: Every evidence rail links one visible claim to at least one labeled supporting observation.

terms.definition: Preserve decision-relevant labels and the product state shown by supplied project evidence.
notThis: A reconstructed state or claim that the source never showed.
acceptance: Visible labels, values, and status agree with the supplied project evidence.
The artifact leads with one claim, connects it to labeled proof, and preserves the shown product state.
